title: happy client: 443 open, every other probed port closed
titleZh: 正常客户端:443 通,其余被探端口全关
why: The positive control for the client side. It proves the suite can also produce a good verdict, so a green result is not the same as 'nothing was tested'. The isolation probes (135 / 5357 / the DSH port) must all be reachable=false: a peer that exposes its own DSH port would break the loopback-only premise of the whole design.
inject: 443 connected; 135, 5357 and the DSH port refused
expectSummary: PEER_TCP_443 pass/peer_443_ok + PEER_ISOLATION_PROBES pass/peer_iso_ok, no blocked item
